_about: tf1's hand decisions for scripts/build-models.mjs (docs/API.md §3, docs/DATA.md). Quotes here are short exact substrings of the guide page named; the build verifies each one and fails loudly on a miss. Everything not listed is derived mechanically from the guide and verified the same way.

title_names._note: Section titles whose name part can't be split mechanically into unit names. Each value is the list of unit names taken from the title; each must occur in the title.

toc_expand._note: Slash names in the table of contents that list variants. Value k: the last k words of the first part are replaced by each later part (API.md §3 rule 3). Other slash names stay whole (USA IIC+ BRT/DP, Div/13 CJ11).

appendix_aliases._note: Appendix name prefixes (pp. 295-298) that don't start with the model's own name.

body_names.why: The title says 'Euro Blue and Red'; the guide writes the unit name 'Euro Red' in the Euro Uber section's how-to.
Written as a model name in the Prince Tone section body.

settings.context: These were my settings for a killer high-gain tone:
settings.quote: Model: USA IIC+ / Input Drive: 8.1 / Overdrive: 9-10 / Bass: 1.0 / Midrange: 1.8 / Treble: 8.9 / Presence: 4.5 / MV: 4.0 / Level: -20 dB / Bright Switch ON

settings_left_out.text: Or try Bass and Treble at 0, and Mid and Presence at 10
settings_left_out.why: Two labels share one number ('Bass and Treble at 0'); rule 6 only reads a number written right after its label, so Bass and Mid would be shown as guesses beside a guide value that contradicts them.

settings_left_out.text: We recommend starting the amp on the BE channel with the Bass on 10, the Mids at around 6 …
settings_left_out.why: 'on 10' and 'Mids' are outside the rule 6 separators and labels, so only Treble and Presence would parse and Bass would contradict the quote.

settings_left_out.text: Here’s what I settled on: Drive 6.50, Bass 7.00, Middle and Treble 3.50, everything else default.
settings_left_out.why: 'Middle and Treble 3.50' leaves Mid as a guess that contradicts the quote; the two Steve Vai settings on pp. 84-85 are kept.
